svg.aria-label: wf hello-ticket demo: a real run from entry to delivery
svg.title: wf: one ticket from entry to delivery (real output)

g.text: # The ticket, as a file in the repo
`greet('Ada')` returns `Hello, Ada!`. `greet()` with no name still returns `Hello!`.
# Admit it: wf opens an attempt with its own worktree and moves the ticket to In Progress
next: start the planner: `wf handoff planner --agent <id>`
tracker: admitted performed on the ticket files and read back
# The planner freezes the acceptance criteria before any code exists
Start agent type wf-planner (name it planner-1; do not pass a model) with: "Read ~/demo/hello-ticket/.wf-evidence/attempts/HT-1.1/hando…
next: start the implementer: `wf handoff implementer --agent <id>` [wf-implementer]
# The implementer's first try forgets the comma
tracker: implementing performed on the ticket files and read back
Start agent type wf-implementer (name it implementer-1; do not pass a model) with: "Read ~/demo/hello-ticket/.wf-evidence/attempts/HT-1…
wf gate: run 2026-10-06T10-53-38-974Z-8917: 1 to run, 0 reused, 0 skipped or deferred
failed unit no `inputs` declared: always runs
# Fixed and committed: the gate runs again on the new tree
wf gate: run 2026-10-06T10-53-39-249Z-9037: 1 to run, 0 reused, 0 skipped or deferred
passed unit no `inputs` declared: always runs
# The implementer cannot review its own work
wf handoff: implementer-1 planned, wrote or owns this change and cannot review it
# A fresh reviewer checks each criterion against the gate evidence
# Delivery: merged to main, pushed, and the ticket handed off
tracker: delivered performed on the ticket files and read back; attempt closed
SHOW TO OWNER: no screenshots for HT-1: no gate step declares `artifacts`, so the gate collected no screenshots
(recorded; tell the owner this in the delivery report)
next: nothing: this attempt is closed
# Readback: the ticket file as the engine left it, and main as pushed
`greet('Ada')` returns `Hello, Ada!`. `greet()` with no name still returns `Hello!`.
greet() now takes an optional name: greet("Ada") returns "Hello, Ada!".
next: nothing: this attempt is closed
